name: token-tracker
description: Tracks token spending (input, cache read, and output tokens) via Stop hooks and historical transcript backfill, with a lightweight local UI to compare usage across repositories, models, and teammates.

Launch the Token Tracker UI dashboard so I can compare usage with my team
Analyze my cache hit efficiency and top token-consuming conversations this week
